bullets.content: [general] Reference-free estimates understate true error: eta x1.22 on bc7 (0.148-0.151 vs 18-18.5%), ~1.5x on bc0; true field error was 1.2-1.8x the last refinement-pair compare diff. Diffs below 5% are noise (measure noise floor first). compare diff measures change, not error gap. Choose by this pessimistic number.

[general] Use all 4 solves, one factor per solve: S1 base (new variant, never a stored recipe), S2 one-factor change, S3 structurally different recipe, S4 refine at hotspots. One h bracket is enough. Run compare(best, runner-up) before submit (never compare(n,n)); diff under ~5% is a tie, submit cheaper/more distinct. Free mesh() scan first.

[general] Meshing is deterministic: never re-solve a known recipe (a2 reproduced 0.033756 J exactly), never compare(n,n), never solve a mesh whose free mesh() changed nodes <1%. Identical mesh ties, no bonus. 12-18% compare diff between different meshes is real.

[general] One factor per solve, stated. After EVERY solve call view(kind=error) and compare hotspot h to request; if >1.3x, extend/shrink the box over the hotspot. Use all 4 solves; write the 4-solve plan first and keep promises (a7 broke its no-ring promise).

[general] Scan candidates with free mesh() first and note node counts; precompute the energy gain each must reach (break-even) before spending a solve. Plan one control plus three one-factor tests; view(kind=error) after each solve; compare(best, runner-up) before submit.

[general] mesh() replaces the active mesh and solve() uses the LAST mesh call. Re-issue the intended mesh() right before solve() and confirm the node count matches (a0 solved an unintended h 0.008 mesh).

[general] Break-even (below target): missing energy ~ e^2*U; at 16% field ~0.0009 J of 0.0338 J. A change pays when dU/U >= 0.027*dN/N, i.e. >=0.13% energy per +5% DOFs. Compute before every accept/submit.
[general] A compare() diff with >90% share in one low-stress spot is a remesh artifact (a7 bc0: 0.611, energies agreed 2e-5). Check view(kind=error) and judge by hotspots and energy.

[general] Strain energy ranks field error (bc0: 2.13519e-4 8.30%, 2.13391e-4 8.38%, 2.13129e-4 9.05%, 2.11463e-4 11.4%). Neighbour diffs 4.7-5.9% are ties. Above target accept only dSE% >= 0.03 x dDOF%.

[general] Rising strain energy shows the mesh is still stiff (bc7: 0.0299→0.0338 J, 10k→27k DOFs). Energy error is about the square of stress-norm error: ~4% missing energy means ~20% field error. Use extrapolation only as a sanity check.
[general] Hidden-point bonus rewards being uniquely best somewhere, not lowest RMS: a7 won 0.156 with worst RMS (7.98%), a2 won 0.0625 with best (4.65%). A distinct error pattern beats a near-copy.
[general] Edge refinement inside a box of similar size is a no-op (bc0: edge 22 at 0.003 in 0.0035 box changed energy 0.004%). Make local refinements >=1.4x finer than surrounding size, or omit.

[general] Delivered size lags requested by ~1.25-1.4x in thin bands (0.0022->0.0028, 0.0018->0.0026, 0.0035->0.0045). Request ~0.7-0.8x wanted local h; confirm via 'element size near group' and hotspot h. If quality.min <0.105 shift h by 0.0005 or box by 0.0002.
[general] Point refinements are silent no-ops (node count unchanged: 5711->5714, 5661 identical). After every mesh() check node count; use {box} volumes over the hotspot band (e.g. ~3x9x2.5 mm).

[general] Box refinement radius is inert: radius 0.003 vs 0.0015 gave identical meshes (6164 nodes). Don't spend solves on radii; box size and extent are the knobs. Check any new parameter with a free mesh() node count.

[general] Thin walls: read thickness from inspect_geometry. Set local size in high-stress bands <= thickness, with 3-4 quadratic elements across the wall in a band about one thickness high at the clamped root, on both wall faces. Coarse h gives under 1 element and 20-30% local error.
[general] When two refinement boxes meet, overlap them ~3 mm (e.g. lower box to z 0.021, junction from 0.018); at coarse h a coarse seam forms (a4 read 9% low at z≈0.015).
[general] A reaction z-sign flip between meshes under curved-face pressure is quadrature noise, not a setup error, if setup matches the statement. Don't chase it.

[general] Bonuses decide rank on a plateau (diversity +0.1 exceeds base spread). Near-twin recipes (same family, h <1.5x apart) get none. Before the first mesh, list peers' likely recipes, differ on purpose (h >1.5x or other targets), keep base >=90% best, and announce it.

[general] In 3D below target, score ∝ N^(2p-1), e~N^-p. With p≈0.44 uniform refinement is break-even; gains come from moving DOFs into error bands and coarsening elsewhere (a2: h 0.0052 plus targeted edges beat uniform 0.0042).
[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Setup correct in all runs; reuse verbatim: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f2, pressure 4e6 on f23, 2.1e6 on f16. Error is discretisation only.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Plateau: base 0.232-0.237 from 15.1k to 25.8k DOFs; uniform refinement loses. Accept a change only if dM/M >= dN/N (>=0.13% energy per +5% DOFs at 16% field). Move DOFs from bosses/caps into saddles/rims.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] No diversity bonus last gen: all used same targets and h 0.0095-0.015 is inert (nodes 8014 vs 8009 above h 0.012). Differ by targets (saddle/rim-focused, no lower box) or cost band, keep base >=90% best (~0.21).

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Edges 39/8 (f16/f19 rims, x~±0.0195) DO pay: a3 dropping 40/39/8 lost 0.36% energy for -5.3% DOFs; adding 39/8 at 0.0026 r0.003 gave +0.18-0.27% for +4.9-5.8%. Always include; edge 40 and edge 3 do not pay.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Saddle boxes [0.010,-0.012,0.019,0.017,0.012,0.030] plus x-mirror at 0.0026 r0.002 on a2 base: +0.17% energy for +5.7% nodes, field 16.04%, best points 6.47%, biggest bonus (a1). Keep in junction recipes; verify saddle h<=0.0032; fund elsewhere, not upper box.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Clamp ring z~0.056 holds ~20% of error and resists refinement: 4 failed levers (edge 40, annuli, f2 0.003 no-op, ring box z0.0515-0.0575 0.0038 +0.23% for +10.6%). Keep {group f2, 0.0033, r0.005}; spend no solve on ring.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Lower barrel z 0-0.021 (z~0.005 near f23 contested): keep box [-0.022,-0.017,0,0.022,0.017,0.021] at 0.0046 r0.003. 0.0040 failed break-even twice; never 0.0065 (reads 8-13% low); lean recipes <=0.0050.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Junction: use a6 full-ring box [-0.026,-0.0185,0.018,0.026,0.0185,0.036] at 0.0030-0.0031 r0.003 (reaches rims x≈±0.0195 and y-extreme cells; 0.0033 gave h 0.0038-0.0042, 13-21% error). Verify f16/f19 touching h <=0.004; if f16 >=0.0046 add {group f16/f19, 0.003, r0.002}. No points.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Rim edges 39/8 at 0.0021 r0.004 paid +0.38% for +6% nodes in a7's coarse mesh (junction 0.0045); on 24k base they are 0.0026 r0.003. Untested one-factor test: switch to 0.0021 r0.004, check f16/f19 hotspot h<=0.0032. Lean branch (a7 15.1k DOFs, base 0.236): h0.012, junction 0.0040, upper 0.0060, f2 0.0038, lower 0.0050.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Coarse-h four-box idea is now realised (a2). Next: one-factor changes on it (saddle boxes, lower box 0.0040). Alternatives for diversity: h 0.006 with junction and lower boxes (a0 h 0.006 without lower box was weak), or h 0.01 a4-style. Copy principle, not mesh.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Field error binds (16-21% vs points 6.5-11%). Energy ranks it but score ~e^2*N: a1 higher energy than a2 (0.033815 vs 0.033756) yet lower base (0.232 vs 0.237) from +5.7% DOFs. Break-even gains tie: pick the more distinct mesh.

[general] [abc_00000003_bc7] Check-point error never binds. P1 (low-stress clamp ring, -12 to -22%) dominates point RMS; P0 near f16 boss end (~3 MPa) ignorable. Only global h helped P1 and it is break-even. If binding test {group f3, 0.004, r0.003}. Ignore f15/f17/f25 caps.
[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Setup correct in all runs; reuse verbatim: 3d, E 2.1e11, nu 0.3, fixed f12, pressure 2.1e6 on f7. Error is discretisation at clamp root.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Above target score is g/(2c): cut DOFs; need >=0.03% SE per +1% DOFs. Base spread 0.70-0.75, no diversity earned: differ in TARGETS (arc-end sub-boxes, pocket x 0.0125, f52 strip, wall x-min 0.008), base >=0.68; announce.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Arc-following root: edges 22 and 18 (f5∩f12) at 0.0016-0.0018 r0.002 gave best field 8.26% and points 5.49% (a5, 5859 nodes, root 0.0022). Radius 0.003 or size 0.0014 exploded nodes to 6600-9400. Pair with root 0.0025, no sub-boxes; target <=5600 nodes.

[general] [abc_00000065_bc0] Never coarsen wall box or root: wall top z 0.002 -0.57% SE; root 0.0026 w/o sub-boxes -0.27%; wall 0.0045+ reads f7 cell 131 5.6% low. Keep wall box 0.0035 (max 0.004) full height; never replace sub-boxes with edges 22/18 over 0.0025 root (9.05%) unless root 0.0022.
